name: IP102: Large-Scale Benchmark for Insect Pest Recognition
description: A comprehensive large-scale benchmark dataset for insect pest recognition in agriculture. Curated by the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA) and Nankai University. Comprises 75,222 images covering 102 insect pest categories organized hierarchically under 8 major economic agricultural crops (rice, corn, wheat, beet, alfalfa, millet, citrus, and mango). Includes nearly 19,000 images with bounding box annotations for simultaneous pest localization and classification.
